data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to display and validate random number captcha dialogs
data.what_it_does: Flutter plugin to display a random number captcha dialog and validate the user input. It allows customization of texts and colors, and returns a boolean indicating whether the entered number is correct.
use_when: You need a simple number captcha dialog to prevent basic automated submissions
You want a ready-to-use validation dialog with customizable texts and colors
avoid_when: You need complex visual captchas like reCAPTCHA or image recognition
You require advanced bot protection mechanisms
strengths: Easy to use with a single static show method
Supports custom properties like title, placeholder, and accent color
weaknesses: Provides minimal configuration options compared to full captcha systems
